name: Spicy Steak Pizzaiola (Italian Braised Beef) with Mushrooms & Peppers

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, pat steak dry with paper towels. Season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg striploin (New York strip) steak
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add steak and cook until golden brown, about 2 minutes per side (it will not be cooked all the way through). Transfer to a plate. (Reserve pot with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 red bell peppers
3 yellow bell peppers
0.68 kg cremini mushrooms
1 small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips. Place in a large bowl.
Thinly slice mushrooms. Add to the bowl with the bell peppers.
Peel, halve, and slice onions crosswise into thin half-moons. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the bowl (reserving a small handful for serving).
Return pot (with drippings) to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, basil, and spices; cook, stirring often, until the veggies have softened, 6-7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp oregano, dried
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add tomatoes, broth, and tomato paste to the pot; stir to combine the sauce. Bring to a simmer, then nestle steak into the sauce and cook, turning once, until sauce has thickened and steak is desired doneness, 7-8 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (398 ml) cans diced tomatoes
237 ml chicken or vegetable broth
3 tbsp tomato paste

instructions.primary_message: Transfer the steak to a cutting board and thinly slice against the grain.
To serve, divide veggies and sauce between plates or bowls. Top with sliced steak, Parmesan, and reserved basil. Enjoy!
